content: मारीच {%a.%} (-ची|{%f.%}) Belonging to or composed by Marīci. .{@-चः@} .²1 <ab>N.</ab> of a demon, son of Sunda and Tāḍakā. He assumed the form of a golden deer, and thus enticed Rāma to a considerable distance from Sītā, so that Rāvaṇa found a good opportunity to carry her off. .²2 A large or royal elephant. .²3 A kind of plant (<lang>Mar.</lang> <ns>कंकोळ</ns>). .²4 <ab>N.</ab> of the sage Kaśyapa; <ab>cf.</ab> स्वायंभुवान्मरीचेर्यः प्रबभूव प्रजापतिः <ls>Ś. 7. 9</ls>. .²5 A sacrificing priest. .{@-ची@} .²1 <ab>N.</ab> of the mother of Śākyamuni. .²2 <ab>N.</ab> of a Buddhist goddess. .²3 <ab>N.</ab> of an Apsaras. .{@-चम्@} A collection of pepper shrubs.
